text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Yukino Bijin and I are organizing
her fan
letters. Because of her booming
popularity,
there's quite a lot of them!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gett'n much done here. I can't
stop m'self
from rereading them...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Release a photobook, Yukino!"
"Will
you hold more fan events?"
"You're so
pretty. My daddy and I are gonna
come
watch you race."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... I've got all sort of fans—even
little
kiddos.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's kinda heartwarm'n... Ev'ryone's
cheer'n me on
in their own way. I'm so
grateful for each and
ev'ry one of 'em.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Really? I wanna read it right away, hehe!
choice_data_list: あ、新しい手紙も届いているよ

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Okay... it starts, "This is my first time
writing."
choice_data_list: じゃあ、ちょっと休憩にしよう

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Figures. A lot of the letters have been
from new
fans.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um! It's just... this person... They're
apparently...
Uh, I'll just read it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I've been a fan of yours since I saw you
on
running in the track club back in
elementary
school."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I've been cheering for you from the
sidelines all
this time. It makes me so
happy seeing you find
all this success, I
just had to write you."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"You've grown so much since your
undefeated
days back in Morioka. Now
you're in the centrals,
and I know that
you'll continue improving. I'll
always be
watching you!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I bet it can be awful lonely being so
popular, but
I'm still excited to see you
reach bigger and
bigger heights."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Y'know... I appreciate all the
support I
get, no matter who it's from,
but...
choice_data_list: こんな人もいるんだな
こんな人もいるんだね

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that there's someone out there
who's
been watch'n me since forever is...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Huh? It's strange... It's like...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I just wanna get better 'n' better! Not
just for me,
but for them as well!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I think that's the best way I can thank
ev'ryone!
